profile.title: Executive succession
profile.description: Private discovery between an executive who is not looking and an organisation that has no announced search: person-to-organisation, asymmetric by nature, identity gated on both sides.

role.subject: side_dependent
role.subject_note: A fact for the candidate (roles they can credibly hold), a requirement for the organisation (the role to fill).

sector.subject: side_dependent
sector.subject_note: A fact for the organisation, an accepted set for the candidate.

company_arr_eur.subject: side_dependent
company_arr_eur.subject_note: A fact for the organisation (its ARR), a preference for the candidate (the scale they will consider).

location.subject: side_dependent
location.subject_note: A fact for the organisation (where the role sits), an accepted set for the candidate.
location.description: Hierarchical: a candidate holding `france` under accepted_set answers compatible to `paris`. An organisation holding `paris` as a fact answers compatible to `france` by the hierarchy rule.

equity_pct.subject: side_dependent
equity_pct.subject_note: A requirement for the candidate (minimum equity), a preference for the organisation (the envelope it can offer).

principal_identity.subject: fact
principal_identity.description: Declared so its handling is explicit: identifying, never retrievable, travels only under reveal_identity (specification Section 10.6).

joint_predicates.name: package_feasible
joint_predicates.semantics: There exists an equity level inside both the candidate's floor and the organisation's envelope. Each side evaluates the other's candidate package privately; overlap with an asked band proves nothing on its own. On the wire: each side asks `equity_pct compatible_with <level>`, a whole-percent candidate; the predicate holds when both directions answered `compatible` to the same level.

qualification.opportunity_meaning: A qualified Opportunity asserts that role, sector, location and scale were each examined and found compatible -- or, for a value its holder keeps evaluation-only, conditionally compatible, and then listed in open_conditions -- and that package_feasible held for at least one candidate equity level answered in both directions. It asserts neither identity, nor availability, nor that either Principal has decided anything.
